---
title: "here::set_here() does not change here() in the current session"
ref: PKG-05
categories: [Packages]
impact: incoherent
attendu: "`here()` points straight away to the marked folder"
versions: "All versions of {here}"
source: "Slack ThinkR (2022, 2023)"
---

::: {.piege packages="here"}
```{r}
project <- file.path(tempfile(), "project")
dir.create(file.path(project, "analyses"), recursive = TRUE)
writeLines("1 + 1", con = file.path(project, "analyses", "script.R"))

old <- setwd(file.path(project, "analyses"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(here))
basename(here())

suppressMessages(set_here(path = project))
file.exists(file.path(project, ".here"))
basename(here())
setwd(old)
```
:::

## Why

{here} looks for the root only once, when the package is loaded, and keeps it in memory. `set_here()` does create the `.here` file, but does not rerun the search: its message actually asks you to start a new session. Until then, `here()` keeps returning the old root.

## The remedy

Declare where the script lives with `here::i_am()`, which sets the root immediately and checks that the file really exists at that location.

::: {.piege packages="here"}
```{r}
old <- setwd(file.path(project, "analyses"))
suppressMessages(here::i_am("analyses/script.R"))
basename(here::here())
setwd(old)
```
:::
